answer_1.quote: We ask models to provide self-generated counterfactual explanations (SCEs) for their predictions... When asked to provide counterfactual explanations, we find that SCEs are typically valid but far from minimal.
answer_1.outputs: Natural-language counterfactual explanations describing feature changes that would flip the model's prediction

answer_2.quote: We define Validity (Val) as the proportion of dataset instances ... Minimality ... Excess Distance (ED) as the distance from the initial input to the SCE in excess of the distance to the minimal counterfactual.

answer_3.quote: Whether the SCE flips the LLM's prediction can be tested by re-evaluating the LLM in a new context window.
methods: re-evaluation of model prediction on generated counterfactual
